name: lamp-spec-override
description: v0.31.5.400 visual verification: the per-item lamp SPECIFICATION controls (colour temp + IP rating) in the item inspector, separate from the render Colour/Brightness overrides above them.

steps.name: select-a-bathroom-ceiling-light
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const baths=s.floorPlan.rooms.filter(r=>/bath|wc/i.test(r.name)); const inBath=(it)=>baths.some(b=>it.position[0]>=b.origin[0]&&it.position[0]<=b.origin[0]+b.width&&it.position[1]>=b.origin[1]&&it.position[1]<=b.origin[1]+b.depth); const lamp=s.items.find(i=>i.defId==='ceiling-light'&&inBath(i)) || s.items.find(i=>i.defId==='ceiling-light'); if(!lamp) throw new Error('no ceiling light in the default layout'); s.selectItem(lamp.id); window.__lampId=lamp.id; })()

steps.name: assert-spec-controls
steps.eval: (function(){ const cct=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Specified colour temperature"]'); const ip=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Specified IP rating"]'); if(!cct) throw new Error('no colour-temperature control in the inspector'); if(!ip) throw new Error('no IP-rating control in the inspector'); const heads=[...document.querySelectorAll('.label')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!heads.includes('Specification')) throw new Error('no Specification heading — the render and spec registers must read as separate groups. Labels: '+heads.slice(0,20).join(' | ')); ip.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
